history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all — no bars, nothing loads, and I can't send picture messages. It's completely dead as far as the network goes.

I can help you troubleshoot this issue. First, I need to identify your account to check for any line or account problems. Could you please provide your phone number, customer ID, or your full name and date of birth?
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Your line is currently suspended, which is why you have no service. However, your recent bills are already paid, so the suspension is not due to an overdue bill.

Could you please confirm if you recently requested a suspension, or if you experienced any issues with your account or service before this happened? This will help me determine the next steps to restore your service.
I did not request a suspension and I haven't had any issues with my account recently. Can you help me get my service restored?

Your line has been restored and is now active again. Please reboot your phone to regain service. After restarting, you should see your signal bars return and be able to use your phone as normal.

If you still have issues after rebooting, let me know and I can help you further.

history.content: My phone rebooted successfully, but I still don't see any signal bars and nothing is loading. What should I try next?

Let’s continue troubleshooting your service issue. Please check your phone’s status bar and let me know what icons or messages you see at the top of your screen (such as Airplane Mode, No Signal, or any network indicators like 4G/5G). This will help me identify the next steps.
I see Airplane Mode, No Signal, and Data Disabled icons at the top of my screen. What should I do next?

Here’s what you should do next:

1. Turn off Airplane Mode. This will re-enable all wireless connections, including cellular service.
2. Enable mobile data so your phone can connect to the internet.

After you’ve done both, check if you see any signal bars or network indicators (like 4G/5G) at the top of your screen. Let me know what you see or if you still have issues.
I turned off Airplane Mode and turned mobile data ON. The status bar still shows No Signal and I don't see any signal bars.

Thank you for updating me. Since Airplane Mode is off and mobile data is on, but you still see "No Signal," the next step is to check your SIM card status. Please check your phone’s SIM card status and let me know if it shows as active, missing, or locked (with a PIN or PUK code). This will help us determine if the issue is related to your SIM card.
My SIM card status shows as active. What should I do next?

Since your SIM card is active but you still have no signal, the next step is to check your phone’s network mode preference. Please check which network mode your phone is set to (such as 5G, 4G, 3G, or 2G) and let me know what it displays. This will help determine if your phone is trying to connect to an unsupported or weak network type.
I'm not sure which network mode my phone is set to. Can you guide me on how to check that?

To check your phone’s network mode preference, follow these general steps (the exact wording may vary slightly depending on your device):

1. Open your phone’s Settings app.
2. Tap on “Connections” or “Network & Internet.”
3. Select “Mobile Network” or “Cellular Network.”
4. Look for an option called “Preferred network type,” “Network mode,” or similar.
5. It should display options like 5G, 4G/LTE, 3G, or 2G. Note which one is currently selected.

Let me know what network mode is currently set on your phone, and I’ll advise you on the next steps. If you have trouble finding this setting, let me know your phone’s make and model for more specific instructions.
My phone is currently set to 5G as the preferred network mode.

Thank you for checking. Since your phone is set to 5G and you still have no signal, let’s try reseating your SIM card. Please power off your phone, remove the SIM card, wait a few seconds, reinsert it securely, and then power your phone back on.

After your phone restarts, check if you see any signal bars or network indicators. Let me know if this resolves the issue or if you still see “No Signal.”
I removed and reinserted the SIM card as you suggested, and my phone powered back on, but I still see 'No Signal' and there are no signal bars. The SIM status is active. What should I try next?

Thank you for following those steps. Since your SIM card is active, your line is active, your network mode is set correctly, and you still see “No Signal,” the next step is to check your phone’s APN (Access Point Name) settings. Incorrect APN settings can prevent your phone from connecting to the network.

Please check your APN settings and let me know if they appear correct or if you see any errors or missing information (such as the APN name or MMSC URL). If you’re unsure, let me know what you see, and I can guide you further.
My APN settings show the APN name as 'fast.telecom.net', but the status says 'Not set'. The MMSC URL is 'http://mms.telecom.net/mms/wapenc'. What should I do next?

Your APN status showing “Not set” indicates a configuration issue, which can prevent your phone from connecting to the network. The next step is to reset your APN settings to the default values.

Please reset your APN settings on your phone. After resetting, reboot your device to apply the changes. Once your phone restarts, check if you have signal bars or network connectivity.

Let me know if this resolves the issue or if you still see “No Signal.”

I reset the APN settings to default (APN: internet, MMSC URL: http://mms.carrier.com/mms) and rebooted my phone. After the reboot, I still don't see any signal bars and the status bar says 'No Signal.' What should I try next?

Thank you for resetting your APN settings and rebooting your phone. Since your SIM card and line are both active, your network mode is set correctly, APN settings are now default, and you still see “No Signal,” we have tried all standard troubleshooting steps.

At this point, your issue may require advanced diagnostics or account-level intervention that I cannot perform. I will transfer you to a human agent who can investigate further and resolve your service problem.
